g.text: Moodle AIOps · Safe, Verifiable Incident Recovery
TARGET REFERENCE ARCHITECTURE / End-to-end thesis pipeline / AWS EC2 • Linux • Docker Compose
Ansible deploys pinned images to EC2
AWS CLOUD / VPC — scoped internal connections, logical EC2 role groups
⑧ scoped remediation → exact target; no unrestricted shell
Fresh contract probes: allowed works · forbidden blocked · related healthy
11 EXPERIMENT & OFFLINE EVALUATION — ground truth never enters inference
Same fault suite and repeated runs
Safety gate vs safe shadow no-gate
Blue: observe Purple: reason Orange: controlled mutation Green: verify Dashed: context / feedback / evaluation
Design assumptions: roles may share EC2; subnet/region sizing is deferred. Evidence persistence shown as PostgreSQL target. Every logo is embedded offline.
